source_validation.scope: source geometry, contacts and explicit opening hosts

assumptions: Correction cell rings represent physical source spaces with horizontal floor/ceiling boundaries.
Contacts describe adjacency, not traversability or EnergyPlus surface pairing.
Only explicit openings are represented; absent observations do not establish a solid wall.
Source boundary identity follows cell identity and ring order; topology edits need identity migration.
ceiling_height: F1=3.0m, F2=3.6m, absolute total 6.6m, all measured from North/South/East/West elevation outer dimension chains (3600/3000/6600)

Door heights: F1:D_W_main measured ~2.13m from West_view.png pixels; F1:D_ext_S set to 2.1m by visual-proportion match to the measured main door; all remaining doors (all interior partition doors on F1 and F2, none visible in any elevation) assumed 2.1m standard height, consistent with the measured value but not independently confirmed per-door

Window sill/head heights measured from North/East/South_view.png dimension chains per floor and facade family (F1 offices 1.0-2.6m, F1 corridor 1.0-2.8m, F1 narrow accent window 1.5-2.4m, all F2 windows 4.0-5.8m absolute i.e. 1.0-2.8m floor-relative); South/West facades assumed to share the measured North/East chains by symmetry where not independently re-measured
Plan spaces were compiled deterministically from the declared footprint and physical partition segments; no snapping, extension, clipping, or inferred partition was applied
No stairs/vertical circulation observed in either plan view; the two floors are modeled as independent stacked volumes with no vertical connection

unresolved: Pixel-to-world plan calibration (both 1f_view.png and 2f_view.png) was derived by the agent from dimension-chain tick marks and wall-corner crops, not independently re-verified by a second method; F2 calibration shows a ~0.7% x/y cross-axis residual, within expected reading tolerance for a lightweight BIM
Interior door heights (all doors except F1:D_W_main and F1:D_ext_S) remain an explicit assumption; no elevation shows interior partition doors
F1:D_ext_S height is a visual-proportion estimate, not an independently measured dimension chain
F1 south-facade windows W_S2/W_S3 and all F2 south/west-facade windows are assumed to share the measured North/East-facade dimension chains by symmetry, not independently re-measured on every facade
Door open/closed state is unknown for all doors; not marked in either plan drawing

input_view_status.note: Only this run's hash-bound view_image returns are counted. Other image tools, workers and prior runs are outside this scope. A returned image is not proof of examination, complete coverage, correct interpretation or applied heights. Use supplied relevant elevations to check each floor's opening heights; do not transfer a typical height to an unexamined opening family.

room_use_review.next_action: Use-basis records saved; unresolved inferences remain explicit.
room_use_review.interpretation: Counts cover structured role_evidence only, not semantic correctness. Legacy source_refs may contain other evidence. Unknown remains a fallback when no defensible listed use fits; it is not a preferred response to ambiguity.

decision.reason: Matches North_view.png measured dimension chain for F1 office windows

claims.reason: North_view.png vertical dimension chain at F1 (3000mm floor) reads 400/1600/1000 from ceiling down: 400mm lintel gap, 1600mm window height, 1000mm sill-to-floor. Same window family (~2400mm wide desk-height office windows) appears on both North and South F1 facades for these rooms. Origin is F1 ceiling at absolute z=3.0m, direction -1 (downward).
unresolved: South-facade windows W_S2/W_S3 assumed to share the North-facade chain; not independently re-measured on South_view.png

decision.reason: Matches East_view.png measured dimension chain for F1 corridor window

claims.reason: East_view.png vertical dimension chain at F1 (3000mm floor) reads 200/1800/1000 from ceiling down: 200mm lintel gap, 1800mm window height, 1000mm sill-to-floor, for the corridor-level window. Origin is F1 ceiling at absolute z=3.0m, direction -1.

decision.reason: Matches South_view.png measured local dimension chain for the narrow accent window

claims.reason: South_view.png local vertical dimension chain beside the entrance door (F1, 3000mm floor) reads 600/900/1500 from ceiling down: 600mm lintel gap, 900mm window height, 1500mm sill-to-floor, for the narrow accent window next to the south entrance door. Origin is F1 ceiling at absolute z=3.0m, direction -1.

decision.reason: Pixel measurement of West_view.png main door confirms ~2.1m standard door height

claims.reason: West_view.png shows the main entrance double door as a full elevation rectangle. Measured pixel span (door top to floor line) against the calibrated overall 6600mm building-height dimension chain gives door height ~2130mm, i.e. a standard 2100mm door height. Using image_axis with the calibrated y-anchors and the measured door top/bottom pixels.

decision.reason: Matches North/East_view.png measured dimension chain for F2 windows, applied across all F2 facades

claims.reason: North_view.png (and matching South/East/West) vertical dimension chain at F2 (3600mm floor, absolute base z=3.0m, ceiling at 6.6m) reads 800/1800/1000 from ceiling down: 800mm lintel gap, 1800mm window height, 1000mm sill-to-floor. This chain is identical on all four F2 facades (meeting rooms, offices and corridor windows). Origin is building top at absolute z=6.6m, direction -1.
unresolved: South/West F2 windows assumed to share this chain by symmetry with North/East; not independently re-measured on each facade

decision.reason: Visual proportion match to measured West main door height, best available evidence for this door

claims.reason: South_view.png shows the south exterior door as a full-height door-like elevation rectangle spanning from floor to near ceiling, visually matching the same proportions as the measured West_view.png main entrance door (~2100mm). No separate dimension label is given for this door, so the West-door measured height is applied by visual proportion match.
unresolved: No explicit dimension label for this door; height inferred from visual proportion match to the measured West main door, not an independent chain

current_claim_state.note: Current numerical/context consistency only; neither retained nor confirmed means drawing truth.

height_coverage.note: Coverage means a current adopted z binding, not proof that the drawing or BIM is correct. Inference and declared values do not count as located-image height evidence.
